card.statement:
Below, to lighten notation (and since this does not play any role for us) we will not distinguish between the ind-scheme $G_{\mathcal{K}_{x}}/G_{\mathcal{O}_{x}}$ and the associated ind-variety $\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G,x}$ . We leave it to the attentive (and interested) reader to check which version is more appropriate in each statement.

We define

$\mathcal{D}_{x}=\mathrm{Spec}(\mathcal{O}_{x})\quad\text{and}\quad\mathcal{D}_{x}^{\times}=\mathrm{Spec}(\mathcal{K}_{x}).$

For a $\mathbf{C}$ -algebra $R$ , we consider the completed tensor products
$R\,\widehat{\otimes}\,\mathcal{O}_{x}$ and $R\,\widehat{\otimes}\,\mathcal{K}_{x}$ ,
so that

$R\,\widehat{\otimes}\,\mathcal{O}_{x}\cong R[\hskip-1.0pt[t]\hskip-1.0pt]\quad\text{and}\quad R\,\widehat{\otimes}\,\mathcal{K}_{x}\cong R(\hskip-1.0pt(t)\hskip-1.0pt).$

We set

$\mathcal{D}_{x,R}=\mathrm{Spec}(R\,\widehat{\otimes}\,\mathcal{O}_{x})\quad\text{and}\quad\mathcal{D}_{x,R}^{\times}=\mathrm{Spec}(R\,\widehat{\otimes}\,\mathcal{K}_{x}).$

For a $\mathbf{C}$ -algebra $R$ , we set

$X_{R}=X\times_{\mathrm{Spec}(\mathbf{C})}\mathrm{Spec}(R)\quad\text{and}\quad X_{R}^{\times}=(X\smallsetminus\{x\})\times_{\mathrm{Spec}(\mathbf{C})}\mathrm{Spec}(R).$
card.label: Remark 7.1

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
